title: Menopause — things you can do
claims: The NHS advises eating well, exercising and looking after mental wellbeing to help with perimenopause and menopause symptoms.
For bone health, the NHS recommends regular weight-bearing exercise where the feet and legs support body weight, such as walking, running or dancing, plus resistance exercise such as using weights.
The NHS advises calcium-rich foods such as milk, yoghurt and kale, some sunlight on the skin, and vitamin D supplements.

For hot flushes and night sweats, the NHS lists light clothing, a cool bedroom, a cool shower, a fan, a cold drink, reducing stress, and avoiding or reducing triggers such as spicy food, caffeine, hot drinks, smoking and alcohol; it also lists regular exercise.
The NHS states that taking HRT can reduce the risk of osteoporosis.
